description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'CsvDataImportFactoryTest' that tests the 'CsvDataImportFactory' class within the 'OrangeHRM' HRM system. It includes setup and a test method verifying the factory's behavior in creating 'PimCsvDataImport' instances.

classes.name: CsvDataImportFactoryTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class to verify the behavior of CsvDataImportFactory in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CsvDataImportFactory instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetImportClassInstance
methods.description: Tests that the factory's getImportClassInstance method returns an instance of PimCsvDataImport when passed 'pim'.
